slides.text:
5 secrets to actually
reach your body goal

1 — Consistency beats
intensity

Boring workouts, repeated,
are the ones that win

2 — Protein at every meal

Not just after the gym

3 — Track something

What gets measured
gets managed

4 — Sleep is training

Recovery is where
the change happens

slides.heading: 5 — Personalize everything
slides.body: SOMA reads your watch, your sleep, your meals — and turns them into a plan built for your body
